name: Pay As You Go
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach a payment two pools could make. Noise with the Core Set's three pool cards — Cyberfeeder, The Toolbox, Crash Space — beside Overclock, whose credits compete with theirs on every pump and break; viruses for Cyberfeeder to install. Vantage Point's Take a Dive in Jailbreak's place, so an Anarch run gives the Corp bad publicity. Eternal-legal only. Vantage Point Stage 3b: Chain Reaction for Overclock. Vantage Point Stage 4a: The Tungsten Tailor for Scrounge and a Wildcat Strike. Stage 5b: Nurse Hạnh for two Smartware Distributor. Stage 7c: two Hackerspace for two T400 Memory Diamond, and a third Nurse Hạnh for Smartware Distributor, to be installed onto one. Stage 7e: two Stick and Poke for two Wildcat Strike, so the first ice each turn gains a subroutine. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 1: two Friend of a Friend for two Sure Gamble, and two Valentina Ferreira Carvalho, which the tags Friend of a Friend takes and removes pay. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 6a: an Alarm Clock and a Sure Gamble for the Gordian Blade and a Crash Space. Spare Parts' one copy, with no influence left for a second, was installed in about one random game in nine and never by the heuristic Runner, and a 256-seed sweep missed it altogether once the Corp decks it met changed. The Automata Initiative Stage 3: two Banner for two of the three Corroder, fracter for fracter. Parhelion Stage 2a: two Finality, two Katorga Breakout, two Nga and two Num for two Fermenter, two Leech, a Take a Dive, a Cyberfeeder, a Nurse Hạnh and a Buzzsaw.
